session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend from the Open Spike and Channel All Day Trend' (Fri 09:45-16:00 RTH; inset Daily ETH chart 6/2-6/3 trapped 5/19 bears exit breakeven). Large gap down opening bear spike into a tight bear channel (wedge bear flag to 50% of the bear spike then contracting triangle bear flag), MM bear spike and daily EMA magnet, wedge bear flag to EMA sold on first touch, a double bottom at 7437 rallying to the EMA, the 3R bear spike, final flag and the final leg overshooting the channel trendline as an exhaustion signal into the 7360 low.
